messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick heads-up — Emiya Tanaka (SWE) is onsite Tuesday 11/21. Panel 11:30–12:30 PT. Need room reservation, remote fallback (Zoom), and a printed visitor badge.
Tanya Li: Got it — are there any accessibility or dietary notes?
Aisha Khan: Emiya requested wheelchair access and is vegetarian. Arrives at 10:10 (San Mateo shuttle).
Mark R.: I'll be the hiring mgr. Panel order: system design -> live coding -> culture. Can we get a whiteboard room with a screen?
Facilities: Reserving Conf-3 (whiteboard + 2 monitors) for 11:00–13:00. Leaving a note for front desk for wheelchair access.
Aisha Khan: Perfect, thanks Facilities. Can we also reserve a small quiet room for the candidate to prep/phone-call 10:15–11:15?
Facilities: Booked "Focus A" 10:00–11:30. Keycode and floor pass will be left at security.
Tanya Li: I'll print the visitor badge and lunch ticket. What lunch do we need to order?
Aisha Khan: Vegetarian boxed lunch (no nuts). Emiya is allergic to tree nuts.
Mark R.: Confirming interviewers: me, Priya, and Leo. Priya will remote in — need solid Zoom setup in Conf-3.
RecruiterBot: Calendar invites sent to panel and candidate. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/123-456-7890 (passcode: Redwood2026). Meeting time 11:30–12:30 PT.
Aisha Khan: Can someone verify AV + mic test at 11:00? Priya is in Tokyo (TZ shift) so low-latency setup matters.
Facilities: AV tech will be on-site at 10:50 for mic + camera check.
Tanya Li: Parking: reimburse via Expensify. Front desk will give a temporary parking permit for visitor lot — add license plate on arrival.
Aisha Khan: I'll DM Emiya the logistics + parking permit code. Also sending accessibility note to security.
Mark R.: In case of last-minute remote-only, what's our fallback?
Aisha Khan: Fallback plan: move to Focus A (room already has camera), send updated Zoom and set candidate to host. Priya to confirm she can take host role if needed.
Priya (via reply): I can host if needed — please set me as co-host beforehand.
Aisha Khan: Noted. Priya will be co-host.
RecruiterBot: Reminder: candidate documents checklist — signed NDA sent, offer packet withheld until loop complete.
Tanya Li: I'll bring spare laptops and USB-C adapter. Also printing the whiteboard markers and wipes.
Aisha Khan: Final checklist for Tuesday morning: 10:00 AV test, 10:15 candidate prep room, 11:00 security badge pickup, 11:30 panel starts. Anything else?
Mark R.: No, looks good. Thanks everyone.
Aisha Khan: Thanks — I'll post arrival update on Tuesday morning in this thread. :thumbsup:
